question: Omuhwezi w’omuishaaja omu nsiimbiro y’eshure, naayenda kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw’Eindimi z’Obuhangwa: “Kworeka okusiima omu miryango arikugarukamu kuraba omu miringo etari emwe n’emwe, nk’okugamba obugambo, okukora eby’okureeberaho, okuseka, n’ebindi.” Ni muringo ki ogurikuba gusaana kushwijuma embeera erikugambwaho?
answer_a: Ha abaana emiringa na za harmoonika, orinde orebe oku barikuzikoresa.
answer_b: Yoreka abaana ebihere by’emiringo, obihumbyeze, reero obireke babe nibabikoresa.
answer_c: Yoreka abaana ekintu ekirikukora omuriro, reero okibise n'omugoye, otegyereze kubashake kukishaka.
answer_d: Yoreka abaana ebishushani by'enyama ezifuyiirwe omu maka kugira ngu bakore eby'okuriraangariza ebirikumanyisa ebirikumukorwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekitaano okureetera abegi be kumanya, kurugiirira aha mukumo, omuziki oguri omu bwengye bwabo obwa buri izooba. Murimo ki ogurikukwata aha beegi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Ekyererezo ky'enyimba kurugiirira aha makuru agyiirwe omu kubuuza
answer_b: No, sharamu omu omutwe ogurikukwata aha by'okuririmba by'omu rurembo n'omugisha gwabyo aha bantu b'omuri obu bwire
answer_c: Kuhangura nariyo kwonka n'okushoborora enyimba ezirikukundwa kuruga omu rukurato rw'abato ab'emitwarize etari emwe n'emwe, ezirikubabahikirira.
answer_d: Baaza abaturanyi baabo, okorobekanirize ebimanyiso ebirukukwata aha muhendo gw'ebyeshemeza ebirukubaho omu bituura byabo

question: Ni ki ekikuratirwa aha bikorwa by'okucungura, ebikozirwe enyima y'okwombeka ekikundi ekirikuteerana, ekiyamba abeeshuri kumanya omutindo gw'ebikorwa byabo ebi baraakore?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza, kuraba omu kubuurirana, ebishushani by'emishomo yaabo, nibaganiira aha rurimi rw'okureeba orurikuteekateekwa.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza emirimo yaabo, nibamanyisa obuhikirire bw'enteekateeka zaabo, ebikozesebwa, n'orurimi rw'okureeba orurondoirwe.
answer_c: Nibarikira ebikozesebwa omu bintu ebirukorwa abakugu b'ebiro ebi kandi babitangaanisa n'ebyo ebirondwa omu mirimo yaabo
answer_d: Nibegyesereza aha mishinga y'okuteekateeka ekakorwa omu matendekero agandi kandi bagyeshushuze kuraba omu ndimi y'okureeba.
